official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Edit SVGs and convert PNG, JPG, and WebP images into editable vector logos, icons, and illustrations directly in ChatGPT. SVGMaker combines image to SVG conversion, AI SVG editing, and text-to-vector generation for designers, developers, and makers.

What you can do:
• Convert PNG, JPG and WebP images to SVG and turn raster artwork into editable vectors.
• Edit and recolor SVGs, and remove backgrounds from images.
• Generate vector logos, SVG icons and matching icon sets, and illustrations from text prompts.
• Design posters, banners, printables, stickers, and T-shirt graphics.
• Create SVG files for Cricut and other cutting machines, including layered designs and silhouettes.
• Create SVG artwork for laser engraving and laser cutting.

Start with an image, an existing SVG, or a text description, then tell SVGMaker what you want to edit, convert, or create.

Limits:
• You need an SVGMaker account. You sign in and approve the connection; the plugin never sees your password.
• Generating, editing, converting and removing backgrounds use credits on your account. The cost depends on the operation and quality, and ChatGPT asks before each one.
• Images and prompts made on a free account are public in the SVGMaker gallery. Paid-account images stay private unless you share them.
• Files are downloaded on svgmaker.io, not in ChatGPT. Whether you can download depends on your SVGMaker plan.
• Tracing a photo gives flat colour regions and loses fine texture.
• It makes still images, not video or animation.
